gungun

Paintings, mandalas and colour, made by hand.

Follow @_gungun.ch on Instagram

Sleepy Panda at Sunset

A little panda dozes on a branch while the sky burns in oranges and reds. Bold black outlines and a pale moon make the scene feel warm, quiet and a bit dreamy.

The Rainbow Owl

A wide-eyed owl in patterned feathers of turquoise, orange, red and green. Every feather is its own tiny design, and the leafy sprig beside it adds a playful finish.

Buddha Among the Peaks

A calm, seated Buddha in front of a golden sun and snowy red mountains, set against a deep slate-blue sky. Small drifting clouds keep the mood still and peaceful.

Scooby, Full of Joy

A cheerful cartoon dog with a huge grin, painted in glowing yellows and oranges. The dark, speckled background with bright brush-stroke blooms makes him pop like a starry night.

Ganesha and the Peacock

Lord Ganesha holding a lotus, with a peacock beside him, drawn in fine black pen patterns on a golden backdrop. The halo of swirls and the mandala petals around him show real patience.

Birds and Peaches

Two bluebirds perched among ripe peaches and glossy green leaves. Soft pinks and corals against a pale sage background give this one a gentle, storybook feel.

Buddha and the Lotus

A serene half-face of Buddha shaded in soft greys, with lotus flowers and a huge fan of mandala patterns behind. The smooth shading against the sharp detail is the heart of this piece.

Mandala Medley

A stack of intricate black-and-white mandalas with a bright pink and orange flower in the centre. The red and green washes on either side make the fine linework stand out.

Four Seasons, One Tree

A single tree whose branches and roots flow across panels of changing seasons: autumn gold, snowy blue, spring green and summer fruit. Stained-glass lines tie the whole country's seasons together.

Cubist Still Life

A bottle, fruit and flowers broken into colourful geometric blocks, in the spirit of cubist art. Blues, oranges, reds and limes sit side by side in a bold patchwork.

Heart in Bloom

An anatomical heart with wildflowers growing out of it, on a deep black background. It is tender and a little surprising, a reminder that love keeps things blooming.

Tropical Leaves at Dusk

Overlapping leaves in greens, blues, corals and purples, each filled with fine rhythmic lines, over a glowing orange sun. A rich, modern botanical piece that feels like a jungle at sunset.

All paintings by gungun. See more on @_gungun.ch.
